Hello,

Yes, your payment arrived. The $81 came through on Shop···· a few minutes ago and the order now reads a $0.00 balance, so nothing further is owed on it.

One last step is on our side: the payment is sitting as authorized and has to be cap····before the shipping hold on the Hammer Miner BC04 comes off. That is not something I can run myself, so a colleague is picking it up today and will confirm it in this thread. Once it is done, the BC04 is released into the batch with the October 29, 2026 ship date, and the tracking email comes to you automatically against this same order number.

You do not need to pay anything again or do anything else in the meantime. If you step away, the confirmation reaches you by email.

Best,
Sarah
Can you check? The team will not get back to me, they never do.

Hello,

I checked it myself just now, so here is exactly what I can see on Shop····.

Your $81 payment went through on our side at 5:04pm Eastern today. It is on the order as an approved PayPal payment, and the order's outstanding balance reads $0.00. Nothing more is owed by you, and you should not pay again.

The one thing still open is on our end: the $81 is approved but not yet drawn, and our system will not lift the shipping hold on the Hammer Miner BC04 until it is. That final step is not something I am able to run, which is why it is with Abel and Georges. They have it now with everything written out, and they are on until 6pm Eastern today. I am sorry you have had to chase this more than once.

Nothing about your order is at risk while that sits. The B.04 stays on Shop···· with its October 29, 2026 ship date, and the tracking mail comes to you automatically against the same order number once it leaves the warehouse. You can follow the batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Best,
Sarah
But can you 100% confirm I made the payment? I don’t want anyone to later say I never did. Because the team doesn’t get back to me.

Hello,

Yes, I can confirm it without any hedging. Your payment of $81.00 on order Shop···· was approved through PayPal on October 16 at 5:04pm Eastern. It is recorded against your order in our system with that date, time and amount, and the order's outstanding balance now reads $0.00.

So that there is no doubt later, I have written that confirmation onto the order itself: the $81 received from you, the date and time, and the note that nothing further is owed by you. Anyone at HeliumDeploy who opens Shop···· sees it. A full copy of this conversation also goes to your email address when the thread closes, so you will have my confirmation in writing as well.

The only outstanding step is ours, drawing that approved payment down and lifting the shipping hold, and that is with Abel and Georges now. It does not affect what you have paid or your place in the batch. The Hammer Miner BC04 stays on Shop···· with the October 29, 2026 ship date, and the tracking comes to you against that same order number.

Best,
Sarah
